textbookBox.concept: Sound is produced by vibrating objects and needs a medium such as air, water or a solid to travel. It cannot travel through a vacuum.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Sound is produced by vibrating objects and needs a medium such as air, water or a solid to travel. It cannot travel through a vacuum.
beats.speakEn: Sound is produced by vibrating objects and needs a medium such as air, water or a solid to travel. It cannot travel through a vacuum.

beats.en: Sound travels as a longitudinal wave of compressions and rarefactions.
beats.speakEn: Sound travels as a longitudinal wave of compressions and rarefactions.

textbookBox.concept: Sound waves carry energy. The speed of sound in air is about 346 m/s at 25 degrees Celsius.
